Chapter 612: Chapter 37: Inconceivable News (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 612: Chapter 37: Inconceivable News (Please Subscribe)

“Ancestor, I speak the truth.” The Maduo Traveler immediately added upon seeing the expression of the Ancient God Ancestor, “I saw it with my own eyes.”

The Maduo Traveler noticed the skepticism in his own ancestor.

In fact, not to mention the Ancestor, even he himself, a party to the events, instinctively disbelieved when he saw Hunyi blow himself up in front of the Galaxy Master.

He thought that Hunyi’s death was caused by other reasons.

Could it be that some Supreme Being intervened in secret, or had the Galaxy Master employed some kind of ultimate weapon?

Only after eliminating all other possibilities did he reluctantly believe it was the Galaxy Master who killed Hunyi.

...

Indeed, Hunyi died by his own self-destruction, but if not for the Galaxy Master, Hunyi would not have self-destructed, therefore, to say the Galaxy Master killed Hunyi is not inaccurate.

And this act of Hunyi further illustrates how terrifying the Galaxy Master is. Hunyi was the strongest Ninth Rank life of this generation in the Tianyu Clan. He didn’t even dare to engage in combat and chose self-destruction directly, which illustrates what?

It shows that he felt he could be completely suppressed at any moment, and in order not to let this avatar fall into the hands of human civilization, he decisively chose to self-destruct.

In a battle between two powerful entities, the simplest outcome is defeat; the next is killing, but the most difficult is suppression.

Suppression means capturing alive, leaving the opponent with absolutely no capability to resist, not even able to commit suicide. Such a scenario generally does not occur among combatants of the same tier.

Even when Hunyi was previously chasing Xilan, he did not aim to suppress but to kill the avatar to vent his anger.

“I understand now.”

The Ancient God Ancestor nodded. Just in the last few breaths, he had contacted several godlords of the Tianyu Clan, confirming that Hunyi indeed died in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, killed by the Galaxy Master.

“Display the scene from that time.” the Ancient God Ancestor immediately said.

The godlords of the Tianyu Clan merely confirmed his question but did not discuss the details of what Hunyi faced at that moment.

The Ancient God Ancestor could sense that this matter had a significant impact within the Tianyu Clan, disturbing Tier 10 and Tier 11 godlords, even the Ancestors were paying attention to this incident.

The mere death of Hunyi could not possibly cause such a stir. Lifeforms like Hunyi, a Ninth Rank of each era, the Tianyu Clan would always have one; many Tier 10 and Tier 11 godlords were once the strongest Ninth Ranks of their era.

The godlords and Ancestors of the Tianyu Clan were concerned about the manner of Hunyi’s death, and the means employed by the Galaxy Master.

The Galaxy Master was already the youngest Ninth Rank in human history, listed on assassination lists by various different species, attracting significant attention.

Now, the Galaxy Master has exhibited such overpowering strength that even a peak clan like the Tianyu Clan felt the prick of threat.

At least for the future, once the Galaxy Master steps into Tenth Rank or even Tier 11, who, in the absence of a Supreme Being, can suppress him in a major battlefield?

“Alright.”

The Maduo Traveler also realized the gravity of the situation. The combat power shown by the Galaxy Master was excessively high. Could it be that he wanted to replicate the spectacle of the Eighth Layer, breaking the myth of special Ninth Ranks within the Ninth Rank Realm?

Special Ninth Ranks typically refer to those lifeforms that have opened more than twenty million Spatial Layers. These strong beings already have the capacity to impact Tenth Rank, but they choose not to advance, instead continuously opening more Spatial Layers.

Such Ninth Rank beings are much stronger than the common Ninth Ranks of the Myriad Heavy Realm, hence they are known as special Ninth Ranks.

Whirrr.

The Maduo Traveler waved his hands, and within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the Galaxy Master appeared voluntarily, swiftly showing the scene of Hunyi self-destructing.

These images, merely what the Maduo Traveler himself had seen, had limited information, but at least the Ancient God Ancestor could glean some truth from these partial snippets.

“Hmm?”

The expression of the Ancient God Ancestor grew increasingly grave, especially just before Hunyi self-destructed.

“The number of Spatial Layers possessed by the Galaxy Master is at least over a hundred million.” the Ancient God Ancestor steadied himself and spoke.

The reason he said “at least” was entirely limited by the Maduo Traveler’s visual capacity. He could only feel the vast, boundless waves of Spatial Layers.

If the Ancient God Ancestor himself had been present, he would definitely have been able to detect exactly how many Spatial Layers the Galaxy Master had occupied, but the Maduo Traveler did not have this ability.

The Ancient God Ancestor could only speculate based on the myriad pieces of information the Maduo Traveler sensed and felt.

“A hundred million Spatial Layers? And at least?” The Maduo Traveler took a deep breath. He was also Ninth Rank and even a special life, possibly not as talented as the Ancestor, but he had also opened nearly a million Spatial Layers.

Even so, the Maduo Traveler was aware of the difficulties involved in developing Spatial Layers, the very essence of space often causing him major discomfort.

A million Spatial Layers were already so difficult, let alone a hundred million.

The development of Spatial Layers is not as simple as one plus one equals two; opening a million Spatial Layers taking a hundred thousand years does not equate to opening a billion Spatial Layers costing ten million years proportionally.

The more Spatial Layers are opened, the greater the difficulty, which increases exponentially.

“This Galaxy Master has the strongest talent and gift I have seen in any being.” the Ancient God Ancestor collected his thoughts, his tone filled with emotion.

As a Tier 11 Peak who had fully comprehended the Rule of Time, the Ancient God Ancestor naturally speculated that the Galaxy Master must have encountered some great fortune enabling him, in one moment, to be pursued while in the next, to turn the tables and counterattack.
